## About
925 Collision Repair is an independent, single location, family, female, small owned business on Concord Ave in Concord. Our team loves cars and cares about yours.
We handle collision repair, dent repair and paint repair, from shopping cart dings to accident damage. Hablamos español.

## Services
- Paint: If a parking lot run-in with a shopping cart left marks on your door, we restore the paint to factory quality.
- Collision repair: After an accident, we take care of the damage and keep you updated along the way so you know where your repair stands.
- Dent repair: Small dings or big dents, we work to leave a smooth surface with no sign of the damage.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with any insurance company.

Q: Do you offer a way to pay over time?
A: Our website mentions zero interest payment for 100 days. Give us a call to ask how it works.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 1410 Concord Ave-C in Concord, CA 94520.
